title: Parent Script #1: the very first step
cta: Free Parent Script Cards · link in bio

copy.caption: Instead of “Why haven't you started yet?” try “What's the very first step?” When your child names the step, they own the start. Less reminding, more ownership. Free Parent Script Cards: link in bio.
copy.yt_title: Homework Fight? Say This Instead (Parent Script)
copy.pin_title: What to Say Instead of “Why Haven't You Started?”
copy.pin_desc: A simple parent script for homework standoffs: ask “What's the very first step?” so your child names the start and owns it. Part of the Julia Redmond executive function series for parents of kids 9-13. Free Parent Script Cards available from Julia Redmond Publishing.
